manual_exceptions.destination: ston_wallet::msgs::ReferencedPayload (field adapter used by both derived InternalTransferMsg records)
manual_exceptions.required_behavior: True selector before the payload reference; context is a separate following reference.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: TLBRef alone writes no selector; an Either would admit the forbidden false branch. A field adapter enforces only this invariant.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Preserve omitted versus present untagged recipient/Either suffix and its validated shape.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Native Option inserts a presence bit; suffix presence here is determined by actual remaining bits/references.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Validate current STON standard recipient before exposing immutable logical fields.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Nullable address fields admit None; this current-generation message requires a present standard recipient.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Restrict original opcode to transfer/burn-notification/sell-notification and retain truncated raw tail.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Primitive u32 decoding cannot enforce the protocol opcode domain.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Restrict tax-wallet bounce domain to transfer/burn-notification; preserve truncated suffix.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Tax and presale bounce domains differ; a derive would admit unsupported original opcodes.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Empty body matches only zero bits and zero refs; nonempty bodies reach Unknown.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: ton_macros propagates derived ensure_empty errors; a variant-mismatch codec permits fallback.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Validate the raw Either tail on decode before exposing a recognized transfer.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: TonCell alone cannot validate the required selector/reference while preserving the complete raw tail.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Reject a bad nested continuation opcode as malformed known data.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Native enum dispatch treats nested TLBWrongPrefix as an outer variant mismatch.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Optional untagged Either payout tail, checked to exhaust the containing derived record.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Native Option writes a Maybe bit; omission here uses zero bits and references.

public_address_api.policy: Required identities use TonAddress/InternalAddress; nullable encoded identities use Option<TonAddress>/NullableAddress. Ordinary structured nullable fields derive FromTVMStack with NullableInternalAddress (Cell/Slice only, rejecting TVM NULL). Explicit optional nullable stacks retain Option<Option<TonAddress>> and protocol NULL behavior. Scalar normalization and Maybe/reference layouts are unchanged.
public_address_api.manual_result_reason: Manual result decoding remains for explicit NULL-returning address fields, dictionary roots (including NULL empty dictionaries), nested tuples or typed-reference layouts. Ordinary nullable fields use the released FromTVMStack field adapter.
